spec_raw: Tree Menu emits duplicate itemClick events for keyboard interactions in collapsed state

spec_refined.title: Tree menu: duplicate itemClick emission on keyboard interaction
spec_refined.description: When the tree menu is in a collapsed state and an item is activated via keyboard (Enter/Space), itemClick fires twice (keydown handler and synthesized click both emit). Exactly one itemClick per activation must be emitted, for both mouse and keyboard, in expanded and collapsed states.
acceptance_criteria: Keyboard Enter on a tree item emits exactly one itemClick (collapsed state)
Keyboard Space on a tree item emits exactly one itemClick (collapsed state)
Mouse click emits exactly one itemClick in both states
Expand/collapse toggling via keyboard emits the correct expand/collapse events exactly once
Event payloads (item id, expanded state) are unchanged in shape
No regression in focus management: focus stays on the activated item
spec_refined.technical_notes: Requires understanding the event flow across keydown handlers and native click synthesis in the Stencil component; risk of breaking ARIA interaction patterns. High coupling: tree-menu is composed with app-menu.
